subject.title: 🐛 Feishu channel fails with tenant_access_token error when HTTP proxy is configured

question: Should Feishu SDK HTTP and WebSocket bootstrap requests use OpenClaw's ambient/managed proxy agent, go direct by default, or wait for a per-channel proxy policy?
rationale: This choice changes the network/security boundary for Feishu app credentials and message delivery, and current related issues show valid user reports on both sides of the proxy-vs-direct behavior.

options.title: Accept the proxy-agent fix
options.body: Review and land the open candidate PR if maintainers want Feishu SDK HTTP to share OpenClaw's ambient/managed proxy behavior while disabling axios' separate proxy path.

options.title: Prefer direct or per-channel bypass
options.body: Reject or revise the candidate PR toward explicit direct-by-default or channel-level proxy policy before changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Document workaround only
options.body: Keep runtime behavior unchanged for now and rely on NO_PROXY or docs guidance, accepting that this issue remains unresolved for affected proxy users.

recommendation.title: Accept the proxy-agent fix
recommendation.body: Review and land the open candidate PR if maintainers want Feishu SDK HTTP to share OpenClaw's ambient/managed proxy behavior while disabling axios' separate proxy path.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Feishu client lines and shared proxy helper history point to steipete as the best routing candidate for the proxy/security-boundary decision.
